name: MAPE-BE
description: CodeEpi is an codebook-guided teacher–student framework for antigen-only B-cell epitope prediction. This release provides the datasets, external benchmark set, and pretrained model checkpoints. The repository contains: (1) CodeEpi_pyg_release_v1.0:PyTorch Geometric formatted datasets used in CodeEpi, including Complex1723, an antibody–antigen complex dataset, and Antigen1321, the corresponding antigen-only dataset. (2) CodeEpi_MAPE-BE_external_testset_v1.0:An external benchmark dataset consisting of non-redundant antigens recognized by multiple paired antibodies. Each antigen contains at least two independent epitope regions.The MAPE-BE dataset was collected from SAbDab2 and processed through quality control filtering. Antigens sharing ≥90% sequence identity with the training sets of six baseline models were removed using MMseqs2 to prevent data leakage. Remaining antigens were further clustered to eliminate internal sequence redundancy, resulting in a clean non-redundant external test dataset. (3) checkpoints_CodeEpi_v1.0:Pretrained CodeEpi model checkpoints, including the trained student models, teacher models and prototype codebook.
